title: Law to require sidewalk-detection tech on shared e-bikes and scooters
summary: This bill would require companies operating e-bike and e-scooter share systems, like Citi Bike, to install technology that detects when a device is being ridden on a sidewalk. Share systems would also need a safety feature that gradually slows and stops the device until it leaves the sidewalk. There is no penalty for a first violation, but repeat violations within two years could bring a fine of up to $1,000, and the law would take effect one year after passage.
